decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s existing recycling-system know-how and already shows a strong customer value signal through the reported annual savings, so absorptive capacity and early market evidence both support continuation.

As a mobile slow-speed shredder close to the established offer, it fits the firm’s knowledge base well and can likely be improved through its in-house R&D and service feedback, making withdrawal unlikely.

Because this modular plant concept is presented as a flagship direction and is strongly related to the firm’s core capabilities, management would be inclined to refine and scale it rather than remove it.

The trommel screen is adjacent to the core portfolio and therefore within the firm’s absorptive capacity, but the weaker visible market signal compared with A and C makes its risk of withdrawal slightly higher while still low overall.
